# First Light: build a model before using logic

NOTES-ONLY-MARKER. Assume no programming or circuit-design knowledge. Explain the source file, model boundary, port direction, and testbench before introducing a constant driver. Use a complete, differently named off-indicator example; the learner decides what value their museum indicator needs.

The starter is an empty but compilable model. Task 1 adds its named one-bit output; task 2 drives the required value. The first stage passes only the interface task; the second passes both. The low-output wrong solution proves that declaring a connection alone does not satisfy its behavior.
